definitions.gloss: to buy up; to corner the market; to hoard
definitions.explanation: To purchase all or most of a particular product, either to monopolize supply or out of panic. Often used negatively to describe hoarding behavior during shortages or speculative buying.

examples.japanese: ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{買|か}い{占|し}められた。
{転売目的|てんばいもくてき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{限定品|げんていひん}→限定品：16189_genteihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{占|し}める⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are people who buy up limited-edition items to resell them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧や⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{占|し}める⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめてほしい。
examples.english: I wish people would stop hoarding water and food before disasters.

notes:
USAGE:
{買|か}い{占|し}める carries a negative connotation, implying selfish or excessive purchasing that deprives others of access. It became especially common during pandemic-related shortages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{占|し}める (to buy up ~)
- ⟦{買|か}い{占|し}め→買い占め：30614_kaishime⟧ (⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧ form — hoarding, buying up)
- ⟦{買|か}い{占|し}め→買い占め：30614_kaishime⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ (hoarding behavior)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦まとめ{買|が}い→まとめ買い：08046_matomegai⟧ (buying in bulk) is neutral — simply purchasing a large quantity. {買|か}い{占|し}める implies buying everything available, leaving none for others. ⟦{買|か}いだめ→買いだめ：08047_kaidame⟧ (stockpiling) implies buying extra for personal reserves.
